title: Pringtemps bi ci suufu suuf si
intro: Ci jaar-jaaru Al Quran, dafa am nit ku am muñ gu mat sëkk ku jànkoonte ak fitna buy yàq xol yu gëna dëgër yi. Lépp lañu ko nangu - alal, njaboot ak wérgi-yaram. Waaye ci biir tiis wu metti wi, ñu tontu ma ñaan gu woyof ci anam wimu ko xaarul woon. Ndax mën nga xàmmee ruuh gi jaar-jaaru defaraat bi wéy di wéy ci jamono yi?
clues: Dañu ma natt ci fitna bu metti ba kenn duko fàttaliku ci jamono yépp.
Ñàkk naa lépp lu am solo - sama alal, samay doom, ak sama wérgi-yaram.
Sama yaram dafa fees dell ak ay gaañ-gaañu yu metti, te ñépp dañu ma bañoon.
Ci sama yaakar, ma woo Yàlla, ni ko seytaane laal na ma ci coono ak fitna.
Yàlla tontu ma, digal ma dóor suuf si ak sama tànk.
Ci barab boobu, ndox mu sedd génn, Yàlla delloosi sama njaboot, yokk leen ñaari yoon ci yërmaande.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
